answer: To prevent Sybil attacks in a decentralized AI agent economy, agents must present a valid cryptographic attestation from a secure enclave. Using a falcon signature scheme ensures high throughput and compact proofs, allowing the network to filter out malicious clones. Even during a gale of automated spam across the vast ocean of peer-to-peer interactions, these verifiable signatures force attackers to incur insurmountable hardware costs to generate valid identities.
